claim_relevant_visible_text: It's probably more than double this year as compared with last year. However, it's still not enough to meet the customers' demand
researcher_paraphrase: In the CoWoS-capacity Q&A, TSMC said it expected capacity to more than double in 2024 versus 2023 yet still be insufficient for customer demand, with OSAT partners used to complement TSMC capacity.
precision_guard: The statement is about TSMC advanced-packaging/CoWoS capacity in the surrounding Q&A. It does not establish that CoWoS was the sole bottleneck for every AI accelerator or that HBM wafer supply was unconstrained.
authority_boundary: TSMC is primary for its own CoWoS capacity and customer-demand statements, not for memory-supplier wafer or HBM-stack capacity.
